name: Alien Keeper
source:
Alien Keeper is a visual novel about raising an alien and all the challenges that entails. You play as a disgraced scientist looking to redeem herself and make a fortune. The easiest way to do that? Buy an alien egg off the black market and raise it as your own! 

[From [url=https://studiomoch.itch.io/alien-keeper]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《外星人守护者》是一部关于抚养外星人以及随之而来的所有挑战的视觉小说。你扮演一位名誉扫地的科学家，想要救赎自己并发家致富。最简单的方法是什么？从黑市上购买一个外星蛋，并将其当作自己的蛋来饲养！

[来自[url=https://studiomoch.itch.io/alien-keeper]itch.io[/url]]
